messages.subject: Lavaan matrix representation
parts:
Hi,

Just came across this problem in the attached reproducible example:

"Error in lavMatrixRepresentation(partable, add.attributes = TRUE) : \n  unused argument (add.attributes = TRUE)\n"
attr(,"class")
[1] "try-error"
attr(,"condition")
<simpleError in lavMatrixRepresentation(partable, add.attributes = TRUE): unused argument (add.attributes = TRUE)>
Error in blavaan(dual_1, data = dat, inits = "simple", convergence = "auto",  : 
  blavaan ERROR: problem with translation from lavaan to jags.
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In if (model.type == "unrestricted") { :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used
2: In if (model.type == "unrestricted") { :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used


Using the latent difference score model, which had worked before with an example I sent. I tried it on 3.2.5 and 3.3.1 and with your most recent devel version.

Thanks,
Ross

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan matrix representation
parts:
Hi Ross,

I suspect the error will go away when you update to the latest version of lavaan (version 0.5-21 came on CRAN within the past week). I just updated the blavaan dependencies to reflect the need for this lavaan version, and I hope to get the new blavaan version on CRAN within the next week or so. (Right now, the devel version of blavaan is the only one that will work with the new version of lavaan.)

Ed
